dimensions.evidence_used: same policyholder series as Customer Growth, over an approximately 6-7 month window
dimensions.rationale: The literal annualized-CAGR formula, applied to a ~6-month window with a 5.6x raw increase, produces an implausibly large extrapolated rate -- exactly the short-window distortion Part 1's own design explicitly warns against. Rather than report that literal (and not meaningfully interpretable as a sustained annual pace) number, this is scored using the dampened, qualitatively-anchored 'Strong' band, consistent with the design's own stated caution. This is the clearest real-world case in this expansion where that caution rule was actually necessary, not just theoretical.
dimensions.anchor_applied: Part 1 architecture's short-window caution rule invoked and applied -- literal CAGR output explicitly NOT used at face value.
